text:
Michael (Support): quick FYI — customer Lumira finished SSO onboarding but their app calls return 403. In console I can see an API key but it's listed under org-root, not the Lumira project.
Alex (Onboard): can you share org id + project id + the key id? also a curl snippet of the 403 response would help.
Michael (Support): Org: org_7h4k, Project: proj_lumira, key id: key_8xY2. curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer key_8xY2" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/text-gen -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> HTTP/1.1 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"Key not scoped to project"}
Alex (Onboard): thanks. likely the provisioner created the key but the claim bound to root org before project binding happened. can you paste the provisioner trace from around 2026-03-12 14:02?
Michael (Support): pasted trace (trimmed):
```
2026-03-12T14:01:59Z provisioner INFO claim created tenant=org_7h4k project=proj_lumira
2026-03-12T14:02:00Z auth-service INFO api-key created id=key_8xY2 owner=org-root
2026-03-12T14:02:01Z provisioner WARN binding failed project not found; fallback owner=org-root
```
Tony (Infra): yep that matches a race we saw earlier — when project record not present in catalogue, we fall back to org-root owner. short-term fix: reassign the key to the project or create a new key in the project and rotate. I can run a manual rebind if you want.
Michael (Support): customer prefers minimal change — they want a working key. what's the exact rebind command?
Tony (Infra): run internal admin API (requires infra privileges):
```
POST /internal/admin/keys/reassign
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "key_id": "key_8xY2",
  "target_project": "proj_lumira",
  "force": true
}
```
This will update owner and trigger policy sync. Note: it's audited and will rotate signing metadata for the key.
Alex (Onboard): long-term we should add a small backfill: if a key is created within N seconds of a claim for the same tenant, attempt to bind to project before falling back. Filed rw-ops#1482.
Maya (SRE): if infra runs reassign, please run a sanity check: call token introspect and verify project claim: `GET /internal/admin/keys/key_8xY2/introspect` -> should include `project: proj_lumira` in response. after that ask customer to retry.
deploy-bot: role-sync job rw-role-sync started for org_7h4k (job id: rs-20260312-443) :gear:
Tony (Infra): reassign done, introspect shows project=proj_lumira and scopes updated.
Michael (Support): relayed to Lumira; they retried and now get 200. customer accepted manual fix and will wait for formal rollout.
Alex (Onboard): thanks — adding sticky note to onboarding checklist to wait for project registry event before finalizing key creation (config flag to extend creation window).
Maya (SRE): filing a short postmortem if we see >1 occurrence in the next week.
Michael (Support): closing for now. workaround documented, customer rotated key to one in their project. :white_check_mark:
